title: Ice Cream Pints with Lids 2-Pack – Make the Ice Cream Right in the Jar
descriptionHtml:
Homemade ice cream is stored in a plastic tub with a crust of ice

The machine does its job, but then everything gets scraped into a tub that neither seals tightly nor looks like anything – and half the batch is ruined by the freezer.

The jars that go from machine to freezer with a lid

Two pints in a 16 oz size with airtight lids. Make the ice cream, put on the lid, into the freezer – and serve from the same jar. Ribbed, transparent glass that shows which flavor is which.

Features

  • From machine to freezer with no in-between steps – make and store in the same jar
  • The lid seals tightly – no ice crust, no freezer taste
  • You can see what's inside – transparent glass instead of anonymous plastic
  • Two jars – one in the freezer while the other is eaten from
